proof:
Source: the Notation paragraph and step 1 of the supplied proof of cmcdt_dilation_pushforward: (δ_λ^#ω)(x)(v_1,…,v_k) = λ^k ω(λx)(v_1,…,v_k), and x ↦ 0 + (λ·id)x is a homeomorphism, hence proper, so the pull-back of Simon 6.2.23 (chapter-06.txt lines 404–410) for f = δ_λ maps test forms to test forms.

Notation: δ_λ(x) := λx on ℝ^P = Euclid P; L := λ·id = lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P). For a k-form ω, affinePullbackForm L 0 ω is the form x ↦ (ω(0 + Lx)).compContinuousLinearMap L (SimonGMT Chapter06/AffineCurrentPushforward.lean). TestFormOn univ k is the submodule of k-forms ω with IsTestForm ω (C^∞ with compact support) and tsupport ω ⊆ univ.

1. Properness. For every x, 0 + Lx = 0 + λx = λx. Since λ ≠ 0, x ↦ λx is a homeomorphism of ℝ^P with continuous inverse y ↦ λ⁻¹y (Mathlib Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero λ). The map x ↦ 0 + Lx equals it pointwise (funext, zero_add), so it is a proper map (Homeomorph.isProperMap).

2. Test form. ω is C^∞ with compact support (ω.property.1). By SimonGMT affinePullbackForm_isTestForm L 0, applied with the properness of step 1, δ_λ^#ω = affinePullbackForm L 0 ω is again C^∞ with compact support. (Directly: it is the C^∞ map x ↦ ω(λx) followed by the continuous linear map α ↦ α.compContinuousLinearMap L on k-covectors; and by tsupport_affinePullbackForm_subset its topological support is a closed subset of the preimage of the compact set tsupport ω under the proper map x ↦ λx, which is compact.) Trivially tsupport(δ_λ^#ω) ⊆ univ. So η := ⟨δ_λ^#ω, ⟨IsTestForm, tsupport ⊆ univ⟩⟩ ∈ TestFormOn univ k, and its underlying form is δ_λ^#ω by definition, so the first conjunct holds by rfl.

3. Pointwise formula. Fix x ∈ ℝ^P and v = (v_1, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^P)^k. By the definitions of affinePullbackForm and compContinuousLinearMap, and since 0 + λx = λx,
 η(x)(v) = ω(λx)(Lv_1, …, Lv_k) = ω(λx)(λv_1, …, λv_k).
 The covector ω(λx) is a continuous alternating, in particular multilinear, map, so scalars come out of each of the k slots: ω(λx)(c_1v_1, …, c_kv_k) = (∏_i c_i)·ω(λx)(v_1, …, v_k) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.map_smul_univ). With c_i = λ for all i ∈ Fin k, ∏_{i ∈ Fin k} λ = λ^k (Finset.prod_const, card (Fin k) = k). Hence η(x)(v) = λ^k·ω(λx)(v) = (λ^k • ω(λx))(v). For k = 0 the empty product is 1 = λ^0 and the formula reads η(x) = ω(λx).

4. Since v was arbitrary, η(x) = λ^k • ω(λx) as continuous alternating maps (ext), for every x. Together with step 2 this proves both conjuncts. ∎
key_steps: For λ ≠ 0, x ↦ 0 + (λ·id)x = λx is a homeomorphism (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero), hence a proper map.

SimonGMT affinePullbackForm_isTestForm: the pull-back of a test form along a proper affine map is a test form; tsupport ⊆ univ is trivial, so η := ⟨δ_λ^#ω, _⟩ ∈ TestFormOn univ k with underlying form δ_λ^#ω by rfl.
Multilinearity of ω(λx) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.map_smul_univ, Finset.prod_const): ω(λx)(λv_1,…,λv_k) = λ^k ω(λx)(v_1,…,v_k), so η(x) = λ^k • ω(λx) for every x (including k = 0).
